profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer 🔹C/C++, Python | Scalable Systems & High-Performance Computing | Embedded Systems | Network Architecture | Automation & Optimisation Expert.
profile.summary:
✭ Hi, I’m Alejandro—a passionate Software Engineer who loves tackling complex challenges and optimizing systems for high performance. With expertise in C/C++, Python, and algorithm optimization, I specialize in designing scalable, efficient solutions that push the boundaries of software development while ensuring seamless functionality and reliability.

✭ Throughout my career, I’ve had the chance to double user capacity, drive 10x performance improvements, and streamline build automation using tools like Makefile and Bazel. I thrive in cross-functional collaborations, working alongside hardware and software teams to deliver cutting-edge solutions that enhance efficiency and scalability in high-performance computing environments.

✭ Beyond coding, I’m passionate about mentoring and knowledge sharing—helping interns grow, refining testing frameworks, and exploring the latest in machine learning and AI. I believe that continuous learning, teamwork, and curiosity are key to innovation. If you share the same drive, let’s connect and exchange ideas!

positions.title: DSP Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Key Responsibilities ➡️ I love making development workflows smoother! I’ve worked on automating builds with Makefile and Bazel, ensuring a seamless process for engineers. I also focus on enhancing legacy features and migrating code to new platforms, solving compatibility issues along the way to keep everything running efficiently and future-proof.

Key Achievements:
- Optimised Control Channel code, achieving a twofold increase in user capacity.
- Collaborated with hardware and software teams to deliver successful product development.
- Engineered library functions using assembly and C intrinsics, boosting performance by 10x.
- Developed and evaluated a new transmission algorithm, analyzing microprocessors for future integration.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Key Responsibilities ➡️ I enjoy building tools that make a difference! I’ve designed Python scripts for automated testing, benchmarking, and performance analysis, mentored interns, and championed best coding practices. I also helped optimize chip screening, improved data collection workflows, and streamlined builds by transitioning from Makefile to Bazel, making development smoother and more efficient.

Key Achievements:
- Designed test vectors using Matlab to validate and verify code accuracy.
Strengthened testing coverage for both new and existing system features, ensuring robustness and reliability.
- Built new tools to optimize testing efficiency, streamlining workflow for the development team.
- Engineered and maintained C/C++ software for a high-performance Giga-bit NLoS wireless access system.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.locationName: Santa Clara, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Key Responsibilities ➡️ I had a great time building a scalable IoT testbed using a Raspberry Pi server and multiple ARM 32-bit Cypress board clients to enable extensive testing. I also integrated TLS and DTLS protocols, strengthening network security and data protection, and making the system more reliable and secure.

Key Achievements:
- Collaborated on research and evaluated various existing algorithms in the field.
- Contributed to an article by analyzing and reviewing algorithmic methodologies.
- Researched and assessed algorithmic approaches, co-writing a published article.
- Examined multiple algorithms and documented findings as a co-author.
positions.insights: Internet of Things, Embedded Systems and +4 skills

positions.title: Software Intern
positions.locationName: Madrid, Community of Madrid, Spain · On-site
positions.description:
Key Responsibilities ➡️ I had a great experience developing a pattern recognition system for TV and radio ads, helping improve ad targeting and analysis. I also designed a hybrid app for work schedule management, using geolocation to make scheduling more efficient and user-friendly. It was exciting to blend technology with real-world problem-solving!

Key Achievements:
- Led the adoption of machine learning tools for pattern recognition in advertising to refine marketing strategies and optimize targeted campaigns.
- Implementing machine learning solutions to enhance pattern recognition for advertising, improving marketing precision.
- Developing and integrating machine learning models to analyze ad patterns and boost targeted campaign effectiveness.
positions.insights: Pattern Recognition, Machine Learning and +5 skills

projects.title: Creation and Analysis of Secure IoT Test Bed
projects.description:
Senior Design Project.
The main objective of the project is to design a test bed for analysis of different protocols and encryption algorithms in a secure communication between an IoT device with reduced resources and a server.
